_package_info.description: The classic nine-axis alignment grid (Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic × Good/Neutral/Evil)
_package_info.author: Storymaster

alignment.name: Lawful Good
alignment.description: Acts with honor and compassion. Follows codes, respects authority, and protects the innocent.

alignment.name: Neutral Good
alignment.description: Does what is good without bias for or against order. Helps others as conscience directs.

alignment.name: Chaotic Good
alignment.description: Follows their own conscience. Values freedom and kindness over law and tradition.

alignment.name: Lawful Neutral
alignment.description: Acts in accordance with law, tradition, or a personal code. Order over good or evil.

alignment.name: True Neutral
alignment.description: Does what seems like a good idea. Avoids strong attachments to ideology or alignment.

alignment.name: Chaotic Neutral
alignment.description: Follows whims, prizing personal freedom above all. Unpredictable but not malicious.

alignment.name: Lawful Evil
alignment.description: Takes what they want within the limits of a code or hierarchy. Methodical and ruthless.

alignment.name: Neutral Evil
alignment.description: Does whatever they can get away with. Loyalty only to self; ruthless self-interest.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description: Acts on greed, hatred, and lust for destruction. Hot-tempered, violent, unpredictable.
